description: This file declares the DataReaderFactory class which implements the IDataReaderFactory interface. It provides a factory method to create IDataReader instances based on media source type and buffer parameters.

classes.name: DataReaderFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating IDataReader instances based on media source type and buffer parameters.

methods.name: createDataReader
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IDataReader object based on the provided media source type and buffer parameters.
